figures.caption: FIGURE 1 Schematic illustration of Li+ transport mechanism, coordination environments, and the formed SEI for R-CPE and PPE.

FIGURE 2 Morphological characterization and crystallographic analysis of as-fabricated SPEs. (a) Optical photo of R-CPE. (b) Top-view SEM images of R-CPE with an inset presenting the cross-sectional view. (c) Comparative FTIR spectra of PPE and R-CPE. (d) DFT-optimized molecular conformations of pristine α-PVDF (left) and MoS2 -induced β-phase PVDF (right) driven by the dipole interaction between sulfur terminals in MoS2 and CH2 groups in PVDF. (e) Electrostatic potential calculation for PVDF and MoS2 . (f) 19 F-NMR and (g) 1 H-NMR spectra for PPE and R-CPE.

FIGURE 3 Li+ solvation structures and transport dynamics. (a) FTIR spectra of N ─C ═ O stretching vibration peak of PPE, R-CPE, and DMF. (b) The percentage of distinct Li+ -FSI− coordination states of R-CPE and PPE. (c) 7 Li-NMR spectra of R-CPE and PPE. (d) Comparative interaction energies for Li+ -FSI− and Li+ -DMF. RDF curves and Li+ coordination numbers for Li+ -O in DMF and Li+ -O in FSI− of (e) PPE and (f) R-CPE. (g) MSD curves and corresponding lithium-ion diffusion coefficient of R-CPE and PPE. (h) Arrhenius plots and (i) ionic conductivity of R-CPE and PPE.

FIGURE 4 Comparative Li/SPEs interface stability of PPE and R-CPE. (a) Tafel polarization profiles and calculated exchange current densities. (b) Critical current density evaluations using symmetric Li|PPE|Li and Li|R-CPE|Li cell. Long-term cycling stability tests of Li||Li symmetric cells at current densities of (c) 0.1 mA cm− 2 and (d) 1 mA h cm− 2 with a fixed charge/discharge time of 1 h. DRT analyses of Li|SPEs|Li cells for (e) PPE and (f) R-CPE during the charge/discharge processes at a current density of 0.1 mA cm− 2 and areal capacity of 0.1 mAh cm− 2 .

FIGURE 5 SEI composition analysis of cycled Li||Li cells at 0.1 mA cm− 2 and 0.1 mAh cm− 2 for 100 h with PPE and R-CPE. Depth-resolved XPS spectra of the lithium surface for (a) PPE and (b) R-CPE. TOF-SIMS depth profiles for (c) PPE and (d) R-CPE. 3D reconstruction of representative chemical species distributions in (e) PPE and (f) R-CPE.

FIGURE 6 Electrochemical performance of solid-state Li|SPEs|NCM811 full cells. (a) The initial three galvanostatic charge-discharge profiles of Li|R-CPE|NCM811 cells at 0.1 C. (b) Rate and (c) cycling performance at 0.5 C of Li|R-CPE|NCM811 and Li|PPE|NCM811 cells. (d) Long-term cycling performance of Li|R-CPE|NCM811 cells at 2 C. (e) Comparative evaluation of long-term cycling performance in Li||NCM811 full cells using R-CPE and state-of-the-art polymeric electrolyte systems. (f) Cycling performance of the Li|R-CPE|NCM811 pouch cell at 0.2 C. DRT analyses of (g) Li|PPE|NCM811 and h) Li|R-CPE|NCM811 cells during the charge/discharge processes at 0.2 C.
